overview.description: The Corgi Beauty, Skincare & Aesthetics ETF (GLAM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer staples equity. The fund actively manages a global portfolio of companies involved in beauty, skincare, and aesthetics. GLAM was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: GLAM is an equity ETF with a total of 26 individual holdings. The top holdings are AbbVie stock at 14.92%, Colgate-Palmolive Company at 7.23%, The Estée Lauder Companies at 5.64%, International Flavors & Fragrances at 5.57%, and Ulta Beauty at 5.24%.
